wordmark.purpose: App name in header only. Widest tracking in the system — announces the instrument.

label.purpose: Section headers, panel eyebrows, functional button text. Panel legend language — identifies then recedes.

body.purpose: Track titles, primary content. Tighter tracking, heavier weight — the signal name.

meta.purpose: Artist names, album titles, timestamps as text. Uppercase, gentle tracking, 40–50% opacity.

mono.purpose: Timestamps, track indices. Fixed-width for tabular alignment. 30–40% opacity.

shadows.name: play-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Play button hover only. The single outward-casting light in the system. State-driven, not decorative.

shadows.name: play-inset-highlight
shadows.purpose: Play button at rest. Faint bevel that reads as a physical button surface.

shadows.name: reactive-border-glow
shadows.purpose: Bass-reactive. Updated at 60fps via direct DOM mutation on --reactive-border. Pulses with each beat; never decorative.

motion.name: spring-control
motion.purpose: Transport buttons, all physical controls. Fast spring — confirms the mechanical press.

motion.name: spring-panel
motion.purpose: PlayerBar entrance slide-up. Heavier spring — panel-weight motion.

motion.name: ease-panel
motion.purpose: Section panel entrances (opacity + y). Expo ease-out.

motion.name: ease-colour
motion.purpose: Album-art colour transitions (--bg-color, --accent-color). 1s duration — slow enough to feel like a scene change.

motion.name: beat-reactive
motion.purpose: Bass-power driven opacity/color updates on active track row and reactive border. Sub-100ms to stay locked to the beat.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below 900px: sidebar stacks vertically, layout shifts to column, overflow-y enabled.

components.name: Transport Button (Resting)
components.description: Prev/Next skip controls. 32px square, near-zero radius. Hardware instrument aesthetic.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-transport" aria-label="Previous track"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M4 3V13" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square"/><path d="M12 3L6 8L12 13V3Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-transport { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid #1f1f1f; border-radius: 2px; color: #e0e0e0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s ease, border-color 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-transport:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-btn-transport:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-transport:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0e0e0; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Transport Button (Active/Looping)
components.description: Transport button in active state — accent fill signals the engaged state.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-transport ds-btn-transport--active" aria-label="Previous track" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M4 3V13" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square"/><path d="M12 3L6 8L12 13V3Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>

components.name: Play Button (Resting)
components.description: Primary play/pause. 44px, slightly larger than transport to mark the primary action.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-play" aria-label="Play"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none"><path d="M6 4L14 9L6 14V4Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-play { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid #1f1f1f; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.10); color: #e0e0e0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s ease, border-color 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-play:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.10), 0 0 20px rgba(112,130,160,0.27); } .ds-btn-play:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-btn-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0e0e0; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Play Button (Playing)
components.description: Play button in active/playing state. Accent fill, black icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-play ds-btn-play--active" aria-label="Pause" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none"><rect x="6" y="4" width="2" height="10" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="10" y="4" width="2" height="10" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-play--active { background: #7082a0; border-color: #7082a0; color: #000; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15), 0 0 20px rgba(112,130,160,0.27); }

components.name: Functional Button
components.description: Header utility buttons. Small, uppercase label, mechanical border. Used for Quality toggle, Reset Filter, Enter Visualiser.
components.css: .ds-btn-functional { font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid #1f1f1f; border-radius: 2px; color: #e0e0e0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-functional:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-btn-functional:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-functional:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0e0e0; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-functional--accent { background: #7082a0; border-color: #7082a0; color: #000; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Track Row (Resting)
components.description: A single track in the search results list. Grid layout, 2px radius, bass-reactive glow when active.
components.css: .ds-track-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 32px 1.5fr 1fr 50px; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #1f1f1f; border-radius: 2px; color: #e0e0e0; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; width: 100%; transition: background 0.1s ease; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-track-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.015); } .ds-track-row__index { font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.3; text-align: center; } .ds-track-row__art { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid #1f1f1f; overflow: hidden; } .ds-track-row__art img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; filter: grayscale(0.5) contrast(1.1); } .ds-track-row__info { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-track-row__title { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-track-row__artist { font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; opacity: 0.4; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-track-row__album { font-size: 0.65rem; opacity: 0.3; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-track-row__duration { font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; opacity: 0.3; text-align: right; }

components.name: Track Row (Active + Playing)
components.description: Active track row with accent border, accent title color, and bass-reactive background glow.
components.css: .ds-track-row--active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-color: #7082a0; } .ds-track-row--active .ds-track-row__art img { filter: none; } .ds-track-row__title--active { color: #7082a0; } .ds-track-row__playing-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7082a0; animation: ds-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; margin: auto; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; } 50% { opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-track-row__playing-dot { animation: none; opacity: 0.8; } }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Panel zone header. 32px height, uppercase panel legend label, accent dot status indicator.
components.css: .ds-section-header { height: 32px; padding: 0 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border-bottom: 1px solid #1f1f1f; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-section-header__label { font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.25em; opacity: 0.4; color: #e0e0e0; } .ds-section-header__dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7082a0; opacity: 0.6; }

narrative.overview:
Waveform is designed as a precision instrument panel, not a music app. The closest physical references are a studio mixing board at rest, a Teenage Engineering OP-1, or a piece of rack-mount audio equipment: dark anodized aluminum, engraved labels, mechanical buttons that depress exactly 1mm, and numerical readouts in a fixed-width typeface. Everything functional, nothing decorative.

The interface exists in two states: standby and active. At rest, the palette is near-monochromatic — deep black backgrounds, faint borders, monitor-white text at controlled opacity. The moment a track plays, the album art drives a full reactive palette through CSS custom properties: backgrounds, borders, accents, and glows shift to reflect the music. This reactive system is the visual signature of Waveform. It is not a theme toggle; it is the interface responding to its input signal, like a meter needle moving.

Typography is compressed and functional. All metadata travels in uppercase with wide tracking, echoing the legend labels on hardware panels. Track titles use tight tracking and heavier weight — they are the signal name, not decoration. Monospace appears only for numerical readouts (time, indices) — data that should read like a display, not prose.
keyCharacteristics: Near-monochrome at rest; album-art-reactive when playing
Square corners throughout (2px maximum radius on interactive elements; 0px on media frames)
Opacity as the primary hierarchy tool within a single hue
Spring physics on transport controls; eased curves on panels and overlays
Uppercase-tracked labels as the dominant typographic voice for all metadata
No decorative shadows; depth through tonal layering and opacity

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: --accent-color is used for exactly three things: the active track title, the playing state on transport buttons, and beat-reactive glows. It never appears as a background on neutral elements or as a decoration on inactive states. Its scarcity is what makes it feel like a signal, not a coat of paint.

rules.name: The Forced Dark Rule
rules.body: No matter what the album art extracts, --bg-color is capped at 8% lightness and --surface-color at 12%. White album? The background is still near-black. The music provides the color; the chassis stays dark.

rules.name: The No Static Accent Rule
rules.body: Do not pick a single hardcoded accent color for the interface. The accent is always derived from the current track. When no track is playing, System Idle (#7082a0) is the fallback — it signals readiness, not branding.

rules.name: The Two-Case Rule
rules.body: Body text is sentence case. Everything else — labels, metadata, section titles, button text — is uppercase. There is no mixed-case metadata in this system; it reads as noise on a dark panel.

rules.name: The Opacity Stack Rule
rules.body: Within a single hue, hierarchy is expressed through opacity, not size. Monitor White at full opacity is the active element; at 0.5 it is secondary; at 0.3-0.4 it is tertiary context. Never introduce a third typeface or a gray value to create hierarchy — use the opacity stack.

rules.name: The No Ambient Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are prohibited on resting UI elements: cards, panels, section containers, list items. If an element needs visual separation, use a border or a 1-step opacity shift. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, active, beat).

dos: Do derive all accent colors from useAlbumColour. The reactive palette is the product's visual signature.
Do use 2px radius on all interactive controls. This near-square shape is the hardware-instrument signature.
Do use 0px radius on all media frames (album art, thumbnails). Images are always square-cornered.
Do express hierarchy through opacity within Monitor White, not through multiple gray values.
Do uppercase all metadata labels with at least 0.05em letter-spacing.
Do use spring physics on transport controls and eased curves on panels.
Do keep --bg-color and --surface-color at ≤8% and ≤12% lightness regardless of album art.
Do use Framer Motion's whileTap on all buttons for press-depth confirmation (scale: 0.95).
Do use prefers-reduced-motion via the useReducedMotion hook to disable beat-reactive and entrance animations.
donts: Don't add border-radius above 4px to any element. No pill-shaped buttons, no rounded cards.
Don't use Spotify/Apple Music patterns: no rounded card shelves, no curated shelf layouts.
Don't build screensaver-energy visualizers — rainbow blobs, looping patterns independent of audio.
Don't add ambient drop shadows to resting elements.
Don't use SoundCloud/YouTube Music patterns: no waveform-as-decoration, no cluttered dark layouts.
Don't introduce a second accent color as decoration.
Don't build standard SaaS dark-mode layouts: no gray sidebar + card grid.
Don't add section headers with the small-caps eyebrow pattern without questioning whether the label earns its place.
Don't use rgba(0,0,0,0) as a hover state. Use opacity-shifted Monitor White layers.
Don't put raw audio data (Uint8Array) in React state or Zustand.
